_meta.note: Placeholder alumni journey records created for the Alumni feature (architecture_master section 24). These are TEMPLATE stories with example career paths and advice; is_verified is false so listings order them after any verified record and the UI can label them unverified. Replace with real, publicly documented alumni journeys (with source_url) during ingestion. university_slug and career_slug are resolved to ids by the seeder.

alumni.name: Sara Ahmed (template)
alumni.career_path: Started with a first-year Python course, built small web projects each semester, interned at a Karachi software house in the third year, and joined as a backend engineer after graduation.
alumni.advice: Build small projects from your first year - a GitHub profile with real work matters more than grades in most interviews.

alumni.name: Bilal Khan (template)
alumni.career_path: Focused on embedded systems electives, joined the university robotics team, completed a hardware internship, and now designs firmware for consumer devices.
alumni.advice: Join a student technical society early - team projects teach you more than any single course.

alumni.name: Hina Raza (template)
alumni.career_path: Cleared MDCAT in the second attempt, completed MBBS house job rotations, and entered a internal-medicine residency programme.
alumni.advice: MDCAT pressure is real but survivable - consistent daily revision beats last-month cramming.

alumni.name: Usman Tariq (template)
alumni.career_path: Started in BBA with a marketing major, led the university marketing society, interned in a brand team, and moved into brand management after graduation.
alumni.advice: Internships are the fastest way to test whether a career actually fits you - apply early and often.

alumni.name: Ayesha Malik (template)
alumni.career_path: Learned SQL and Python alongside the degree, completed Kaggle projects in the third year, and started as an analyst before moving toward data science work.
alumni.advice: Public projects on Kaggle or GitHub give you a portfolio before your first job - start one this month.

alumni.name: Zainab Ali (template)
alumni.career_path: Completed Pharm-D with hospital rotations in the final years, passed the pharmacy council registration, and joined a hospital pharmacy team.
alumni.advice: Use your rotation placements to try different pharmacy settings - hospital, retail and industry are very different careers.
